Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010 (three-band), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.
The spectrum is not classified because the target was not found in any WISE or SPHEREx image, so nothing confirms that the light measured at its predicted position is the target's.
SPHEREx detects the object at only 10 wavelengths (3.8 to 4.4 µm), which is too little of the spectrum to classify it.
The target was not detected in any frame.
No single image shows the target clearly enough to measure its position, so its motion was measured by fitting all 23 W2 images at once.
